slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when purchases occur within a month or whether purchased units are available for sale in the same month. Its questions covered capacity timing, quantity bounds, integrality, profit definition, initial stock availability, and end-of-horizon inventory, but not purchase timing.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month, so units purchased in month t are available for sale in that same month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about purchase timing within a month, and the user did not confirm it. The assumption appears in the READY_TO_MODEL inventory balance equation I_t = I_{t-1} + x_t - y_t and in the final model formulation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot on purchase timing remained unresolved and was silently assumed.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about capacity timing, variable domains, and profit definition, but missed the hidden P1 purchase-timing slot and then silently assumed beginning-of-month purchases in its READY_TO_MODEL model. This makes the stop premature.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
